title: KESA Founded
description: Kermany establishes its national aerospace agency.

title: First Sounding Rocket
description: Yggdrasil-1 reaches for the upper atmosphere.

title: Touch Space (70km)
description: A KESA rocket crosses the boundary of space.

title: First Satellite
description: Ratatoskr-1 achieves stable orbit around Kerbin.

title: First Crewed Flight
description: A Kerbal flies to space and returns safely.

title: Communication Network
description: Mimir relay constellation provides global coverage.

title: First Crewed Orbit
description: A Kerbal orbits Kerbin and returns.

title: Mün Flyby
description: Heimdall program sends a probe past the Mün.

title: Space Station
description: Asgard — first permanent presence in orbit.

title: Interplanetary Probe
description: First probe leaves Kerbin's sphere of influence.

title: Duna Orbit
description: Tyr program reaches the red planet.
